C-items.label: memory items in a list the model opens; open returns the item only (the R2 stage's best arm)

C-items+gather-guide.label: gather-wide plus one guide sentence: open every item that may belong, search again per kind not listed, count only what items say

C-items+gather-guide+relfloor.label: gather-guide plus memory.recall_floor=relative: a per-question floor min(max(0.40, mean+2.5 sd), best) after a 0.55 gate
